title: Dow ends 400 points higher as investors buy AI stocks; Microsoft rallies - The Economic Times
text:
Wall Street experienced gains on Friday, driven by positive performance from Microsoft and AI-related technology stocks. High oil prices and rising US Treasury yields created investor uncertainty throughout the week. Various industries are under scrutiny regarding their prospects related to artificial intelligence advancements. Additionally, traders faced a potential interest rate increase by the Federal Reserve in October.
